LESSON: TALK ABOUT

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
Strand: Phonological By the end of the sub-strand, the  Learners sound sight words repr
Topic 2.4: Talk about

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Talk about. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. relate characters and events in a story to real life experience
2. demonstrate interest to address familiar people using appropriate verbal and non- verbal expressions. 157

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. relate characters and events in a story to real life experience
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to relate characters and events in a story to real life experience. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. demonstrate interest to address familiar people using appropriate verbal and non- verbal expressions. 157
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to demonstrate interest to address familiar people using appropriate verbal and non- verbal expressions. 157. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Talk about using something you see at school.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Talk about.
2. Explain Talk about to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Talk about.
4. Show that you can: relate characters and events in a story to real life experience
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Talk about. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Talk about important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. relate characters and events in a story to real life experience
2. demonstrate interest to address familiar people using appropriate verbal and non- verbal expressions. 157

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
